necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness consistent with a history of atrial fibrillation (I48.91) and sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). Given the concurrent diagnosis of mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0), mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
